expectations.text: Commit message starts with 'chore(' or 'fix(' for dependencies/security
Commit message includes '!' for breaking change or BREAKING CHANGE footer
Includes BREAKING CHANGE footer if not using '!'
expectations.evidence: BREAKING CHANGE footer present in addition to '!'

expectations.text: Commit body includes details about updated dependencies and security fixes
expectations.evidence: Commit body lists updated React, Node.js, security vulnerability fix, removed endpoints, response format changes, performance improvements
Commit addresses dependency updates, security fixes, breaking changes, performance improvements, and issue reference
